inputs.text: [curious] SHOH… nih… SOR… us. His name comes from a place: the Shoshone Mountains, [serious] in the Nevada desert — that's where his bones were found.
[happily] Exactly. He lived two hundred thirty million years ago — [amazed] way before most of the dinosaurs you know.
[curious] A desert, but he lived in water?
[confident] Back then, that desert was a sea. [amazed] The whole region was underwater.
